content.value: In TCP, EstimatedRTT, DevRTT and TimeoutInterval adapt to changing network (14) [CO3] conditions. Suppose, three successive SampleRTT' measurements are recorded as 110 ms, 95 ms, and 120 ms. Given: initial EstimatedRTT = 100 ms, initial DevRTT = 5 ms, α = 0.125 , and β = 0.25
i) Compute EstimatedRTT, DevRTT and TimeoutInterval after each SampleRTT ii) Explain why it is not advisable to use the RTT of retransmitted packets when updating TimeoutInterval
